featured_items.original_text:
$JD | JD. com Q3 revenue rises 3.5% to $46.2B as operating profit rebounds, while the company expands into Europe through its acquisition of MediaMarktSaturn’s parent.

* Earnings: Revenue RMB309.6B ($46.2B); GAAP EPS per ADS RMB4.59 (+35.4%), adjusted EPS RMB5.88 (+57.6%). Net income rose to RMB6.5B, while adjusted net income increased 44% to RMB8.3B.
* Profitability: Operating income reached RMB5.2B vs. a RMB1.1B loss YoY; adjusted operating income rose to RMB7.3B from RMB0.2B. Operating margin improved to 1.7% from -0.4%.
* Segments: JD Retail revenue +2.9% to RMB258B, with operating margin easing to 5.8% from 5.9%. JD Logistics revenue +16.1% to RMB64B, with RMB1.9B operating profit. New Businesses losses narrowed to RMB9.6B from RMB15.7B.
* Sales & Cash Flow: General merchandise +8.1%, marketplace and marketing +9.6%, while electronics and appliances fell 0.7%. Quarterly free cash outflow widened to RMB23.9B from RMB11.2B; cash and short-term investments totaled RMB214.7B.
* European Expansion: Completed the €1.335B acquisition of 59.8% of CECONOMY, MediaMarktSaturn’s parent, on Nov. 12. Consolidation begins that date, excluding the acquisition from Q3 results. Expansion continues through Joybuy and JD’s logistics network.
featured_items.translation_zh:
$JD | JD.com Q3 营收增长 3.5% 至 $46.2B，营业利润反弹，同时公司通过收购 MediaMarktSaturn 的母公司进军欧洲。

* 业绩：营收 RMB309.6B（$46.2B）；按 GAAP 计算每 ADS EPS 为 RMB4.59（+35.4%），调整后 EPS 为 RMB5.88（+57.6%）。净利润升至 RMB6.5B，调整后净利润增长 44% 至 RMB8.3B。
* 盈利能力：营业收入达到 RMB5.2B，而去年同期为亏损 RMB1.1B；调整后营业收入从 RMB0.2B 升至 RMB7.3B。营业利润率从 -0.4% 提升至 1.7%。
* 分部：JD Retail 营收增长 2.9% 至 RMB258B，营业利润率从 5.9% 小幅降至 5.8%。JD Logistics 营收增长 16.1% 至 RMB64B，营业利润 RMB1.9B。New Businesses 亏损从 RMB15.7B 收窄至 RMB9.6B。
* 销售与现金流：日用百货增长 8.1%，平台及营销增长 9.6%，而电子产品和家电下降 0.7%。季度自由现金流出从 RMB11.2B 扩大至 RMB23.9B；现金及短期投资合计 RMB214.7B。
* 欧洲扩张：于 11 月 12 日完成以 €1.335B 收购 MediaMarktSaturn 母公司 CECONOMY 59.8% 股权的交易。合并自该日起开始，该收购不计入 Q3 业绩。扩张通过 Joybuy 和 JD 的物流网络继续推进。

京东（JD.US

利润主要来自费用结构调整。营销开支同比下降26.2%至155亿元，占收入比例从7.0%降到5.0%，公司归因于新业务推广收缩；京东外卖、京喜等新业务的经营亏损从去年同期的157.4亿元收窄至96.4亿元。另一面，研发开支同比增长36.9%至77亿元，履约开支增长7.4%，说明不是一刀切砍成本。收入端的主要支撑是京东物流：639.5亿元，同比增长16.1%，经营利润率从2.3%升至3.0%。

但增长质量要留个问号。京东零售收入2579.7亿元，同比仅增2.9%，经营利润率5.8%基本持平；其中电子产品及家电收入同比下降0.7%，增速靠日用百货（同比+8.1%）和平台及广告服务（同比+9.6%）撑住。另外别误读新业务收入同比下滑49.8%：里面包含分部调整，即时配送相关收入自年初起划入了物流分部，不全是规模收缩。不过减亏不等于盈利，新业务这个季度仍亏近百亿，集团层面的修复还差最后一段路。

海外变量也落地了。据公告，京东于11月12日以13.35亿欧元完成对CECONOMY（欧洲消费电子零售商、MediaMarktSaturn母公司）的收购，取得59.8%股权及投票权，其业绩自当日起纳入合并报表。交易发生在三季度结束之后，对本季业绩没有贡献；四季度并表会带来收入增量，整合成本则是后续需要观察的变量。

接下来盯三个验证指标：电子及家电收入能否回正；新业务亏损能否延续减亏路径走向盈亏平衡；四季度CECONOMY并表后对收入和利润率的实际影响。如果电子品类回正、新业务继续减亏，这轮利润修复有持续性；如果营销费用重新抬头或核心品类继续下滑，本季的利润弹性就更像一次性修复。利润表一个季度可以翻正，电子货架什么时候重新动起来，猫的鼻子一直竖着。

Jan 2026年: US approved sales of 75,000 H200 per company (total 750,000) to China.  But so far, only 20000 pieces (2.5%) are delivered. 

The 10 cleared companies to purchase up to 75,000 H200 each are:  ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent, JD.com Lenovo, Foxconn, New Matrix, Maginfra, Zhejiang Yindun Cloud Technology, and Shanghai Jiatang.

China refuses to buy the 750,000 H200 that already approved by BIS.  Is it stupid, or out-of-money, or both? Let’s look at the recent major GPU data centers in US：

CoreWeave, the biggest pure GPU Neocloud, 50-60% are H200/H100, 10-25% are pre-Hopper (about 130,000 pieces); 20-30% are Blackwell; Vera Rubin just start deploying.  The biggest customers of CoreWeave are  Microsoft, Jane Street, etc.

The data centers used to train Tesla FSD are mainly using H100/H200. Cortex I (2024) uses 100,000 H100/H200. Cortex II (2026) uses 130,000 H100 equivalents (some are Blackwell). Both centers use 230,000 H100 equivalents to train and produce the most powerful, and the only one in the world, self driving system FSD.

SpaceX Data Centers：Colossus I: 200,000 NVIDIA Hopper GPUs (initial 100k H100s built in 122 days in 2024, doubled to 200k H100/H200s in 2025). Colossus II: 550,000+ NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs operational (mix of GB200 and GB300 NVL72 racks), scaling toward ~1M–1.2M GPUs across expansions (Macrohard, Macroharder, Gun Range, Spam).

Recent Colossus rental deals: Anthropic: 220,000+ NVIDIA GPUs on Colossus 1 (H100, H200, and GB200s); ~325,000 total GPUs across initial contracts.  Rental fee: $1.25 billion per month.  Google: 110,000 NVIDIA GPUs.  Rental fees: $920 million per month.
